paths.why: Declares its own version and each version jump has a migration note. The clearest case for the class: drift here is what the applied-version map exists to detect.

Two owners, permanently (Plan-031): the tooling owns the structure — the four levels and what each permits, which migration may restructure per a recorded note, and the template-version gates read the declared stamp — while the repository owns every rule it writes under it. Promulgation never writes here whole; `shaped` is migration's class, not promulgation's.
